definitions.explanation: An intense, vivid shade of red.
Describes a face that has turned red from embarrassment, anger, or heat.
In the expression {真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}, means a blatant lie.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|もみじ}が{真|ま}っ{赤|か}に{染|そ}まった。
examples.english: The autumn leaves turned bright red.

examples.japanese: {恥|は}ずかしくて{顔|かお}が{真|ま}っ{赤|か}になった。
examples.english: I was so embarrassed that my face turned red.

examples.japanese: それは{真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ}だ。

notes:
Part of a series of intensified color expressions using {真|ま}っ〜.

SIMILAR INTENSIFIED COLORS:
・{真|ま}っ{白|しろ} (pure white)
・{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ} (jet black)
・{真|ま}っ{青|さお} (deep blue; pale - from shock)
・{真|ま}っ{暗|くら} (pitch dark)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{真|ま}っ{赤|か}な{嘘|うそ} (outright lie, blatant lie)
・{顔|かお}が{真|ま}っ{赤|か} (face is flushed/blushing)
・{真|ま}っ{赤|か}に{燃|も}える (to burn bright red)
